name: spaces_arrange_nodes
description: Lays out each connected workflow of a Space page as its own left-to-right row, keeping the top-left position. Panels of workflow nodes move as blocks with their layout intact. An unconnected node moves only when it sits on another element, to the nearest free spot; locked and utility nodes stay put. Never creates or removes panels. @see guides_get('spaces')

pageIds.description: Pages whose connected workflow nodes should be arranged. Use exact IDs from spaces_state.
